body:
Exact title matches appear below partial matches.

## Context

- `src/search/rank.py:20` scores title and body matches the same.

## Requirements

1. An exact title match scores above any partial match.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A search for `Mowing` returns the invoice titled `Mowing` first.
- [ ] `min_hit_at_5` in `tests/gold/thresholds.toml` is raised to the new Hit@5, rounded down.
- [ ] `fail_under` in `pyproject.toml` is raised to the new coverage total, rounded down.

## Non-goals

- A new ranking model.

## Test expectations

- pytest: a three-document index, query `Mowing`, the exact match is first.

changes.proposed: `min_hit_at_5` in `tests/gold/thresholds.toml` is raised to the new Hit@5, rounded down.

changes.original: Line coverage must not drop below the current value.
changes.proposed: `fail_under` in `pyproject.toml` is raised to the new coverage total, rounded down.
